pages.text: 2024 was impressive - Baltic Offshore 2024 was impressive - Baltic Offshore About News Seaworks Company presentation film Equipment Bundling machines Cable cutters Cable stands ROTS ROV Work boats Work rafts Services Installations Maintenance Storage facilities Wind farms Mobile Equipment Cable Recoveries Vessels Pleijel Nordkabel Fjord Connector Fjordkabel Nautilus Maxi All references 24kV HVAC Out of service cable recovery Sånga, Submarine cable installation 2 circuits, 24kV submarine cable to Ljusterö 5 Circuits 245 kV HVAC Edsviken 80 kV HVDC Connection Åland – Finland 70 kV HVAC Connection Iceland – Westman Islands 150 kV DC Massimpregnated cable repair 420kV HVAC Cable Installation and Protection Beckomberga-Bredäng 5 Circuits 33 kV HVAC Cable Installation Ålesund 110kV HVAC shallow water installation Väike Väin Kårehamn Windfarm Turnkey Cable Installation and Supply QHSE Career Contact Contact form Menu Item Search About Services Vessels Equipment References QHSE Career Contact Most awesome news about us View all news 2024-12-10 2024 was impressive We started by completing a big project and an investment in new fibre network in Northern Europe. Pleijel had her 5-year renewal during the summer and was then ready to undertake an advance installation project in Estonia. We bet our old floating record with 500m. Our new record, and maybe the new world record (?) is impressive 5300m. The adventure continued when we traveled all the way to Greece and picked up a cable that is now installed in the Stockholm area. At home we extended the cable storage facilities with a turn table for power cables on which we now have the first cables stored. We finished the year with our probably most attention-grabbing repair and conclude that this year was a real adventure. Hope you will join us next year and our next adventure! Merry Christmas and a Happy New Year! This year we are contributing to a better Christmas for more people both far away and locally. pages.text: Aurora submarine fiber optic cable installation projects finalized - Baltic Offshore Aurora submarine fiber optic cable installation projects finalized - Baltic Offshore About News Seaworks Company presentation film Equipment Bundling machines Cable cutters Cable stands ROTS ROV Work boats Work rafts Services Installations Maintenance Storage facilities Wind farms Mobile Equipment Cable Recoveries Vessels Pleijel Nordkabel Fjord Connector Fjordkabel Nautilus Maxi All references 24kV HVAC Out of service cable recovery Sånga, Submarine cable installation 2 circuits, 24kV submarine cable to Ljusterö 5 Circuits 245 kV HVAC Edsviken 80 kV HVDC Connection Åland – Finland 70 kV HVAC Connection Iceland – Westman Islands 150 kV DC Massimpregnated cable repair 420kV HVAC Cable Installation and Protection Beckomberga-Bredäng 5 Circuits 33 kV HVAC Cable Installation Ålesund 110kV HVAC shallow water installation Väike Väin Kårehamn Windfarm Turnkey Cable Installation and Supply QHSE Career Contact Contact form Menu Item Search About Services Vessels Equipment References QHSE Career Contact Most awesome news about us View all news 2024-06-04 Aurora submarine fiber optic cable installation projects finalized Baltic Offshore have completed all submarine fiber optical cable installations in Global Connects investment in a new digital highway, Aurora. Baltic Offshore installed the cables between Sassnitz-Bornholm-Simrishamn, Bornholm-Öland-Gotland, as well as increased the capacity in the route between Copenhagen and Malmö with a new subsea cable. Total length of the installed submarine cables is close to 500 km where the majority of the route has been buried into the seabed by a newly developed jet trencher. “In a large project like this there will be surprises and challenges along the way. Together with our customer and partners we have created innovative solutions to fulfill new requirements and we are proud to have finalized all routes with the highest focus on safety and quality.” says Natalie Franzén, CEO at Baltic Offshore. You can learn more about the projects in Reference projects . A unique and challenging shallow water cable project which includes pre-excavated trenches, floating operation and precision laying of a 5,2 km long 123 kV Cable. The cable also need to be transferred/floated approx. 10 km from the cable lay vessel into the shallow water installation site. Installation work planned to be executed next year 2024 during summer period July-September. The first build-out phase includes two submarine cable systems in the Baltic Sea. Taken together, this means a whole new fiber route all the way from Stockholm to Berlin via Helsinki, the Baltic countries and Poland. Read more at www.easternlight.se Baltic Offshore has been awarded the installation contract. Installation offshore, shorelanding works including splicing and testing. First section to deploy is between Sweden and Finland (from Stockholm via Hanko, Helsinki to Kotka). Fiber cable length apx. 575 km. As a part of the project Stockholms Ström , Ellevio have decided to develop the power grid between Beckomberga and Bredäng. The new HV system consists of 420kV cables and includes both land and submarine cable. The submarine cable system comprises of nine single core HVAC-cables and four FO-cable bundled/attached during installation. The submarine cable route is 5.6 km and has a corridor of 60 m crossing the eastern part of lake Mälaren, from Ängbybadet to Sätravik. The Baltic Offshore scope consists of several work packages to be executed during the period 2019-2022 with the overall plan to take the cable system in operation Q4 2022: 2019 Q4 – Preparatory works – 1500 m duct installation at Drottningholm area and crossing preparations 2020 Q4 – Cable installation and shore-landing trenches – three groups of total 9 cables, 400 kV 2021 Q4 – Cable protection works – installation of 7000 pcs rockbags in fairways and outside Drottningholm area Dela: News archive 2026 2 2025 4 2024 4 2023 4 2022 4 2021 6 2020 4 2019 7 2018 5 2017 2 BALTIC OFFSHORE Stuvaregatan 5 392 31 Kalmar SWEDEN Call: +46 480 420 520 info@balticoffshore.se Made by Kreation Privacy policy & cookies We use cookies and similar technologies to improve and personalise your experience as described in our Privacy and Cookie Notice.
